deleteUserHint: Delete {{name}}? This permanently disables login, revokes sessions and API keys, and removes the user from the list. Financial history and identity references are retained.
deploymentConfirm: Deploy branch {{branch}} to {{host}}? This rebuilds images and updates the Docker stack; service may be briefly interrupted.
deploymentFingerprintHint: Verify this SHA256 fingerprint against your server before saving. Changing it trusts a different SSH host.
deploymentPrerequisites: The server needs Git, Docker Compose v2 and access to GitHub and image registries. Configure docker-compose/deploy/.env first. Only public GitHub repositories are supported. Local code changes or a branch mismatch stop deployment. The worker continues while admin restarts; reconnect to view logs.
deploymentWorkflow: Fetch code → build images → update containers → check readiness
deploymentsHint: Fetch GitHub updates, build on a Linux server, and deploy the Docker stack.
